name: Tatehira Sousuke
source:
"I guess that was a bit complicated for you."
"Just forget about what I said" 

A tall med student first encountered at the bookstore in Okunezato. While he’s rather taciturn and approaches life in an exceedingly logical manner, he’s also surprisingly outdoorsy and has confidence in his athletic abilities.

He tackles any and every problem through the lens of reason. He’s philosophical and has absolutely no sense of humor. When he tells a joke, he has to announce that he’s doing so, lest the punchline be lost on everyone listening.

He’s obsessed with secret licenses and currently holds sixty-four different types of them. He also has a penchant for internet auctions and is constantly looking for goods online.
